pages.title: Extra Life
pages.text: The extra life jingle of Sonic the Hedgehog (Sega, 1991) lasts three seconds. Sonic gets an extra life by collecting 100 rings. Sega Retro lists the jingle as "1-UP" and credits it to Masato Nakamura.

pages.title: Back in the sequel
pages.text: The 1-up jingle of Sonic the Hedgehog 2 (1992) starts all 39 of its melody notes on exactly the same beats as this one in the recordings of both games in this player, so the sequel reuses its rhythm.
